data.description: 【艾莲·乔 · 放学后无人物理私人工作室的私密自抚】夕阳西下的空寂实验室课桌旁，艾莲反锁了房门。百褶裙被轻轻撩起推在腰间。她靠坐在讲台长凳边，纤细的手指轻柔探入湿润花径深处，白皙指尖在温热花褶中慢慢摩挲。硕大的鲨鱼尾巴在身侧蜷曲轻颤，嘴唇微张溢出甜软的低语——「唔嗯……哈啊……明明今天只是想快点回家睡觉的……怎么会变成这样……」

data.promptProse: Golden sunset enters a private post-graduation laboratory where adult Ellen sits alone on an instructor podium. Her sailor-inspired blouse is open below bare breasts and skirt gathered over her lap, with a large shark tail curled safely beside the desk. One hand steadies a beaker rack and the other fingers herself between parted thighs. Black-red hair, red eyes and sharp teeth frame a sleepy expression breaking into a deep blush. Vertical solo portrait, no text or extra people.
